alt: Form DMHC Supplemental Appeal for Expedited Review Fax Cover Sheet and Appeal statement dated August 3, 2026, submitted to the DMHC Expedited Review Unit in Case ending in 44.
full_text: TO: California Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC), Help Center - Expedited Review Unit, Fax: (916) 255-5241. Enrollee: Nicolas Hernandez, Health Plan: L.A. Care, Provider: Carelon, DMHC Case #: ending in 44. RE: Supplemental Appeal of L.A. Care's July 17, 2026 response - request for expedited review and immediate arrangement of clinically appropriate care. Patient requests expedited DMHC review because L.A. Care's July 17 grievance response did not resolve the medically urgent access-to-care problem. Patient is requesting actual clinical management of an established benzodiazepine taper that was interrupted after out-of-network care ended. Interruption of this treatment can cause acute withdrawal, CNS destabilization, and life-threatening complications, including seizures.
summary: This document represents the official 54-page Supplemental Appeal and Expedited Review Request faxed directly to the DMHC Expedited Review Unit on August 3, 2026, and verbally confirmed as received by the DMHC on August 4, 2026, at 1:15 PM. Addressing DMHC Case ending in 44, the appeal aggressively deconstructs L.A. Care's July 17, 2026 grievance response which merely recycled dead-end provider options (Brain Health USA, Inland Psych, Healing Journeys) that were either previously attempted or non-compliant with timely access standards. The appeal demands that DMHC correct its prior administrative merger error, recognize the life-threatening risks of the unmanaged taper, and immediately compel L.A. Care to arrange out-of-network care via a Single Case Agreement.
